prompts.prompt: Precise object edit of the supplied workout animation frame. Preserve the exact existing illustrated woman, face, ponytail, black shirt, shorts with orange seam, shoes, body proportions, bench, barbell and two-post rack. Same camera and positions. Change only: repair silver metal surfaces with missing speckles, complete the abruptly clipped right ends of the two rack storage pegs and bottom right rack foot naturally; remove white floor fragment and white outlines around silhouette. Do not add pegs, alter equipment design, replace the person or redraw clothing. Entire background must be uniform solid vivid RGB(0,255,0) green, including all gaps between bench rails, arms and rack; no shadow, floor, checkerboard or other background. This is a chroma-key intermediate. Keep 4:3 canvas. One image only.

Animation phase edit. Image 1 is the MASTER scene: preserve its woman identity, clothing, rack, bench, all stationary geometry, camera, scale, feet and torso positions exactly. Image 2 is ONLY a bent-elbow motion hint; do not copy its damaged rack or background or camera drift. Create the next frame from Image 1: lower the same barbell vertically about halfway toward her NECK, bending both elbows naturally outwards, with both hands firmly grasping the bar. Keep bar tilt, grip width and plates unchanged. Guillotine bench press: bar trajectory stays above neck, never abdomen/mid-chest. Change only arms/hands and bar position plus correctly revealed background behind them. Keep same solid pure vivid green RGB(0,255,0) background including all enclosed gaps; no floor, shadows, checkerboard or lettering. Same 4:3 framing, one image.

Use image 1 as a locked animation master. Produce bottom phase of this same woman's guillotine bench press. Move ONLY barbell and her gripping hands slightly down to about one inch above the base of her neck, and bend arms accordingly. Elbows flare naturally outward; bar must not cross mid chest or belly. Maintain bar tilt, plate size and grip width. All other pixels especially rack upright top heights, pegs, bench frame, torso, head, feet, clothing, camera, scale and anchors must remain identical to image 1. Do not redesign or shift stationary equipment. Same uniform vivid green chroma background, all gaps green, no shadows, no text, no checkerboard. One 4:3 image.

Edit animation phase only. Preserve image 1 scene exactly: same woman, black clothing orange shorts seam, ponytail, stationary torso/legs/feet, bench, rack, pegs, camera and scale. This is rising phase of guillotine bench press. Lift same barbell vertically upward away from neck until arms are about three-quarters extended, elbows still slightly bent. Both hands grip same shaft firmly; same plate sizes, bar tilt and grip width. Keep rack heights, pegs and all ground anchors identical. No equipment redesign. Reconstruct any background exposed by arms. Solid uniform vivid RGB(0,255,0) green everywhere behind subject and in gaps; no shadow, floor or checkerboard. 4:3 image, no text.

Starting phase of guillotine bench press: arms fully extended holding bar above NECK, hands firmly gripping same bar; straighten elbows slightly if needed without moving shoulders or torso. Same medium grip, plate size and bar tilt. Uniform solid RGB(0,255,0) vivid green background throughout exterior AND all enclosed gaps.
